## Summary
Add ability to crop the selected image before/after scaling, so users can trim unwanted areas directly in the browser without external tools.

## Verification
- Open Photoscaler, pick an image, use crop handle/area to select region, apply crop and verify preview shows cropped result.
- Scale and Download still work on cropped image; original guard (max 8000px) still enforced.
---
## Intent
User asked to "add crop image feature" — capture as-is: allow cropping an image in the app. Cleaned from speech-to-text typos, intent is in-app crop.

## Assumptions (unverified)
- App is Vite + React SPA at `src/App.tsx` with canvas scaling in `src/lib/scale.ts` (`scaleImage`/`canvasToUrl`, `imageSmoothingEnabled` toggle, 8000px max guard).
- No existing crop logic/library; will add new crop utility alongside `src/lib/scale.ts` (e.g. `src/lib/crop.ts` or extend scale) and wire into `App.tsx` flow (pick → crop → scale → preview → download).
- Interaction: draggable/resizable crop rectangle (mouse/touch), aspect-free by default; may add presets later — assumed free-form first.
- Implementation likely uses Canvas `drawImage` source-rect cropping, then feeds cropped canvas/image into existing `scaleImage` pipeline.
- Tag `minor` tentatively — change appears isolated to `src/App.tsx` + `src/lib/*` (2-3 files), no backend — re-tag to `major` if grill reveals wider scope (e.g. new deps, Capacitor share flow).
- No backend/storage; client-side only, consistent with current 100% Canvas approach.
